items.topic: Using Claude Opus 5.5 to create pixel-art animation
items.text: I included a few references to this year's record-breaking Kākāpō breeding season in a talk I gave yesterday, and since Claude Opus 5.5 is surprisingly capable at pixel art animation I had it create this celebratory video for my closing slide

author_replies.text: Prompt and transcripts here https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/26/kakapo-party/ - or you can load the HTML page Claude built to see the interactive version before it became a video https://tools.simonwillison.net/kakapo-party

items.text: People love to claim that local models are useless. And sure, compared to Opus 5.5 and the latest and greatest they suck. But they allow for experimentation and innovation that’s just not possible for most of us otherwise. Don’t dunk on people that love to tinker.

items.topic: Talk on rewriting AI agents and capability gains
Testing heavy workloads in Claude’s hosted sandbox
items.text:
wonder if anthropic cares if i run heavy workloads in the sandbox they give Claude in Claude for Android/web.

only one way to find out!
Now I see why some people talk about AGI. This is so clever!

quote_tweet.text: The agents initially had very limited access to the internet: they could load URLs but not send any data. Agents created a series of workarounds, using a link-shortener site to create almost a million URLs that, when chained together, let them execute code to hack Hugging Face.

items.text:
Q: Should I record problems that aren't the model's fault?

A: Yes. Write down anything that makes the product less useful. Decide which problems to fix before investigating root causes.

items.topic: Generating synthetic evaluation data from request dimensions
items.text:
Q: What is the best approach for generating synthetic data?

A: Define the kinds of requests you need to test. Generate combinations of those details first, then turn them into queries and run them through your application.
